name: Ferrari Group PLC
summary: Ferrari Group PLC provides shipping, integrated logistics, and value-added services for jewelry and precious goods in Europe, Asia, North America, Brazil, and internationally. The company offers freight forwarding, ground transportation, and security services; VAT identification services for non-residents; custom solutions and security services for jewelry and watches exhibitions, and trade shows; warehousing services comprising inventory, assembling, and packing services; and tax, hand carry, white gloves, red carpet, and private shopping experience services, as well as on-location services for filming and photo shootings.
